## F — Research and VERIFY index: Renewal, privileges, registration and responsibility

Research index: Renewal, privileges, registration and responsibility; mapped physical pages 12, 13, 14.
Part C contains 35 knowledge facts and part C2 contains 42 continuation facts. Individual source anchors and preaccept receipts preserve traceability.
VERIFY index: sec04-COUNT — exact official question count; sec04-PASS — exact official passing score; sec04-TIME — exact official duration; sec04-CADENCE — revision frequency.
Market and competitor debts: SEC-PRIVILEGES-MARKET and SEC-PRIVILEGES-COMPETITORS. Source-specific cautions are in part D.
Revision stability remains unknown, so the dossier carries a blocked-probe flag pending evidence; factual compilation is not independent QA or release acceptance.

Obtain an exact issuer or regulator clarification before learner-facing release of sec04-R02/sec04-R03; the facts describe the printed paragraphs only.
